title: CrestApps Mailing Lists configuration
description: The settings of the Mailing Lists module read from appsettings.json, in the OrchardCore section of the host or a tenant.

MailingLists.description: The provider outbox, the retention of unconfirmed sign-ups and the cap of confirmation e-mails.

SyncBatchSize.description: How many member changes the provider outbox sends in one batch.

SyncMaxAttempts.description: How many times the provider outbox tries a member change before it marks the member not synced.

PendingRetentionDays.description: How many days an unconfirmed sign-up is kept before it is deleted.

ConfirmationCap.description: How many confirmation and claim e-mails one address may be sent for one list within ConfirmationCapMinutes; 0 turns the cap off.

ConfirmationCapMinutes.description: The window, in minutes, of ConfirmationCap.
